description: Read one public profile and get the numbers back: follower count, following count, posts count, bio, verified flag and avatar. Works on Instagram, TikTok, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon, GitHub, Pinterest, SoundCloud, Linktree, Medium and Telegram. Mastodon handles are always `user@instance` — the local name alone identifies nobody. Requires an API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` — free key at https://honesthook.com/docs#key; costs 1 credit.

handle.description: The account handle, without the leading @. On Mastodon it must be `user@instance`, because the same local name exists on many servers.

platform.description: Which platform to read the profile from.

name: fetch_profile
title: Fetch a public profile
